descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使做的纸菜单，三明治两边各有一只正忙着的小手。
descriptions.en: My handmade menu gives the sandwich two occupied little hands.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我的纸菜单记着一张没能规整留半的面饼，糖只在一边。
descriptions.en: My paper menu remembers an unevenly saved pastry with sugar on one side.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在纸签上压了两个小凹点，记着邮包搭扣的问候。
descriptions.en: I pressed two small dents into my paper tab for the mailbag’s greeting.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使将一张纸折得矮矮的，纪念蹲着多迈出的那一步。
descriptions.en: My low paper fold recalls the extra step I took while still crouching.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的折卡要展开才看得全，只记一段停顿，不复制标本标签。
descriptions.en: My card unfolds slowly to remember a pause, without copying a herbarium label.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 两道自压短痕后面留着宽宽的空白，是我给那段安静步路做的纸品。
descriptions.en: I left a broad blank space after two short pressed lines to recall the quiet walk afterwards.
